curve.target_group: prime-order subgroup generated by official ECC2K-130 G

factor_base.construction: Enumerate nonzero phi values in the 13-dimensional ONB subspace and its 131 Frobenius conjugates; lift x=phi^-1+1 to the binary curve, project by [4], and retain the exact distinct nonidentity prime-subgroup points. The ordered basis and full point set are digest-bound.
factor_base.sign_frobenius_quotient_rule: One representative per signed 131-step Frobenius orbit; use the exact subgroup Frobenius eigenvalue for every lift and verify all orbit collisions.

field.basis: gamma_i = zeta^i + zeta^(-i), i=1..131; squaring permutes coordinates by fold(2*i mod 263); official polynomial generator maps to the audited ONB coordinate onb_root
field.element_encoding: 131-bit integer coordinate mask; bit i is the coefficient of gamma_(i+1), little-endian
field.representation: permuted Type-II optimal normal basis; inversion-fixed symmetric vectors in the cyclic ring of length 263, modulo the all-ones vector

point_decomposition.cache_policy: Reuse only the exact in-run curve, factor base, orbit map, and independently verified factor logs. Rebuild each target-dependent formula; do not cache a target answer.
point_decomposition.equation_order: Exact selector and algebraic-variable insertion order emitted by the digest-bound m16 formula template with DIM=13 and M=12.
point_decomposition.internal_matrix_kernel: CryptoMiniSat native XOR/Gaussian elimination with at most 10000 rows, 15000 columns, and 10 matrices; this is internal PDP work, separate from final relation-matrix LA.
point_decomposition.monomial_order: Exact digest-bound selector/algebraic-variable insertion order. Leaf i is restricted to its position-specific Frobenius domain F_i=Frobenius^i(V); the domains are disjoint away from excluded zero, and the formula imposes no separate leaf-permutation quotient.
point_decomposition.query_limits: Per-query wall, conflict, memory, solver-matrix, and model limits are frozen in the paired run protocol.
point_decomposition.solver_family: CryptoMiniSat XCNF with native XOR and CDCL
point_decomposition.summation_polynomial_or_chain: Twelve-leaf P_phi,3 addition chain over the binary curve; select one of the four audited order-four cofactor-fiber endpoints of the supplied target.
point_decomposition.weil_descent_encoding: Boolean encoding of the P_phi,3 addition-chain equations over GF(2^131) in the frozen ONB coordinate representation.

relation_collection.duplicate_and_dependency_handling: Preserve verified rows; exact FLINT modular rank trace records novel rank and checks dependent equations for consistency.
relation_collection.filtering: Exact valid-selector membership, decoded curve-point lift, prime-subgroup membership, signed-point uniqueness, and exact group-equation replay.
relation_collection.precomputation_policy: At most 8,192 singleton target queries, each bounded by 600 seconds and at most four decoded models; test rank after 256 surplus verified rows and then after each additional 256 rows.
relation_collection.primary_workload_policy: Exactly one previously unseen supplied public Q; no batch or multi-target amortization.
relation_collection.stop_criterion: Stop target-independent collection after rank 4,134 is attained and every recovered factor log independently replays, or preserve the attempt-limit, timeout, failure, or OOM result.
relation_collection.target_query_distribution: Target-independent preparation uses sequential independent uniform nonzero scalar multiples aG, exactly one target per query; the primary online query is the one supplied public Q.
relation_collection.verification: Independently decode each model, verify all twelve leaf points and the partial addition chain, fold signed Frobenius orbits, normalize rows to sum(row_i*FB_i)=[4]target, and replay in the curve group.
relation_collection.walk_or_sampling_rule: Direct one-target point-decomposition queries; no walk

relation_linear_algebra.implementation_version: FLINT 23.0; source- and binary-hash-bound native worker
relation_linear_algebra.orbit_quotient: Signed 131-step Frobenius orbit quotient across 4,134 columns
relation_linear_algebra.rank_criterion: Full column rank 4,134 with every relation equation replayed
relation_linear_algebra.rank_schedule: First check at 4,390 verified rows, then every additional 256 rows
relation_linear_algebra.row_construction: Fold signed Frobenius terms into 4,134 columns and normalize each row to a positive RHS; known-scalar preparation rows use 4a mod r.
relation_linear_algebra.solver: FLINT fmpz_mod_mat exact modular forward elimination and back-substitution

timing_breakdown.equation_replay: Native modular replay of every relation against recovered logs
timing_breakdown.input_parse: Native worker parses the sparse relation TSV
timing_breakdown.input_serialization: Python relation records written to the exact worker TSV
timing_breakdown.matrix_build: Native worker builds each exact modular row from sparse terms

target_descent.policy: Direct twelve-summand decomposition of the one supplied Q; verify its row, dot with independently replayed factor-base logs, multiply by inverse(4) modulo r, and replay [a]G=Q.
target_descent.success_condition: Exact scalar replay against the supplied public Q
